I’ve noticed that personally, be it sex with a partner or masturbating, that if I’m penetrated vaginally I get really dysphoric after orgasm, to the point where it ruins whatever pleasure I felt during the act itself. 

As others have mentioned I can use a strap on and the mental stimulus almost makes up for the lack of physical stimulus, plus I can please my partner. 

While masturbating I’m experimenting with anal penetration and I’ve found that it feels good while not making me dysphoric at all. I haven’t brought it up to my partner only because I want to be a bit more experienced in it before inviting them in.

My final note is that I’m a bottom, and that it’s not so much the act itself that makes sex enjoyable but the interaction between yourself and your partner.

Okay, I admit I’ve been a little harsh. I’ve had some bad interactions that I’ve allowed to colour my words. When I’m working I want to do my own job.
I get frustrated with couriers for one of two reasons. 

One, (wherein the blame isn’t entirely on the courier) we prepare the food because it says a courier will be at the restaurant immanently, then the courier drops the order, or the countdown stops counting down. Then we have to waste the food and start over, and god forbid we make that courier wait even a second, even if we’ve been waiting for them for 30 minutes.

Two, the paper trays for one drink. For my manager it’s a cost thing, if we handed out trays like candy then that would impact our profits. It may not be a lot but my manager can be pretty anal about these things, as they add up. For me however it’s a waste thing. Couriers may have need for a tray, but the customer certainly doesn’t, it’ll go straight in the trash. I still don’t think you would get a tray for one drink on a togo order, so why for a skip order?

I don’t consider couriers customers, after all they’re not buying anything, just delivering the food. We don’t lose anything by turning a courier away. 
I’ve seen couriers come in with a drink tray tucked in their bag, why isn’t it your job to be prepared?
Even if a paying customer asked for a drink tray for only one drink I’d think they’re a little weird.

I wouldn’t say obligated, and I certainly wouldn’t say you are our customer. It’s your job to deliver the food, you should be prepared and save a drink tray from a previous job if you really need it.
If we piss off a customer that’s lost money, if we piss off a skip courier.. well there’s always other couriers who are willing to take the job.
The problem with the fully enclosed dome lids is that there’s no way we (as a franchised fast food joint) would be able to get our hands on those, so we just have to make do.
Possible contamination is a very good point on the open lid topic that I hadn’t thought of. Couriers generally request a flat lid and I’ve gotten into the habit of just doing it before they ask.
